name: com.parkgraph/mcp
title: Park Graph
description: Find, price and book parking at Park Graph lots and events: quotes, holds, sessions, driver tools.

tools.name: search_lots
tools.description: Finds parking near where the driver is going: place is a U.S. address, venue, landmark or city ("Coors Field, Denver"), or send lat and lng. Nearest first, with spaces left and the current price. vehicle narrows the list to lots that take a car, truck, tractor-trailer or RV, with truck rates where a lot sets them. No API key needed. Results include bookable Park Graph lots (lots; each id is the lot_id that get_lot, the quote tool and reserve take) plus public directory lots (unlisted_lots, with a page_url; not bookable). The top-level summary is a one-line, plain-language answer. An empty lots list means no bookable Park Graph lot near there. Every payment completes on parkgraph.com with the driver present; no tool charges money on its own.

place.description: Where the driver is going: a U.S. address, venue, landmark or city ("Coors Field, Denver", "JFK Terminal 4"). Sent in place of lat and lng.

lat.description: Latitude of the driver's destination, sent with lng

lng.description: Longitude of the driver's destination, sent with lat

radius_km.description: Search radius around that point, in km

vehicle.description: Only lots that take this vehicle. truck covers box trucks, trailers and tractor-trailers; rv means lots with oversized spaces.

tools.name: get_lot
tools.description: Everything a driver needs about one lot: address, map point, spaces, features, hours, prices and spaces left right now. Takes the lot_id from search_lots. No API key needed. Every payment completes on parkgraph.com with the driver present; no tool charges money on its own.

tools.name: quote
tools.description: What parking at a lot costs for a number of hours, at the lot's current price (daily max applied). No API key needed. booking.mode in the result is the next step: reserve (the reserve tool holds a space) or pay_at_qr_page (booking.pay_url is the lot's pay page, where the driver pays and parks). Every payment completes on parkgraph.com with the driver present; no tool charges money on its own.

duration_hours.description: How long the driver will park, in hours

tools.name: reserve
tools.description: Holds space at a lot for the driver for a few minutes and returns booking_url, the lot's pay page on parkgraph.com (opened on duration_hours when it is sent). No API key needed. A hold takes a real space until it expires or the driver pays. Lots that take payment at their QR page place no hold: the result is status pay_at_qr_page with a pay_url, the lot's pay page. Every payment completes on parkgraph.com with the driver present; no tool charges money on its own.

intent.description: What the driver needs, in plain words (optional)

ttl_seconds.description: How long the hold lasts, in seconds

duration_hours.description: Hours to book. The result's booking_url opens the lot's pay page on this length

plate.description: Plate to pre-fill on the pay page

agent_platform.description: The calling assistant's platform (recorded on the booking)

idempotency_key.description: A repeated key retries safely. Generated when omitted and returned in the result.

tools.name: get_session
tools.description: Looks up the driver's parking: lot, status, start and end times, rate, amount so far and extensions, with a link to the driver's session page. No API key needed. Requires phone_code (the 6-character code on the driver's receipt or pass) and plate_last3 (the last 3 characters of the plate), or session_id with session_code. Any mismatch returns the same answer, SESSION_NOT_FOUND. Every payment completes on parkgraph.com with the driver present; no tool charges money on its own.

phone_code.description: The 6-character phone code printed on the driver's receipt or pass

plate_last3.description: The last 3 letters or numbers of the license plate parked on the session

session_id.description: Session id, from the driver's session page link. Sent with session_code.

session_code.description: The session's code (sess_…), sent with session_id

tools.name: extend_session
tools.description: Adds time to the driver's active hourly parking, once the driver pays for it. No API key needed. Requires phone_code (the 6-character code on the driver's receipt or pass), plate_last3 (the last 3 characters of the plate) and extend_hours (0.5 to 8, in half-hour steps); session_id with session_code works in place of the two codes. Returns the price, the new end time once paid and a pay_url to the driver's session page, where the driver pays. Nothing is charged and the end time doesn't move until the driver pays there. Any mismatch returns the same answer, SESSION_NOT_FOUND. Every payment completes on parkgraph.com with the driver present; no tool charges money on its own.

phone_code.description: The 6-character phone code printed on the driver's receipt or pass

plate_last3.description: The last 3 letters or numbers of the license plate parked on the session

session_id.description: Session id, from the driver's session page link. Sent with session_code in place of the phone code.

extend_hours.description: Hours to add: 0.5 to 8, in half-hour steps

tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Finds dated events (games, concerts, shows) at the venues in Park Graph's event network, each with its parking: q is the question in plain words ("Knicks game Friday", "Taylor Swift MetLife Nov 14"), with optional date or from and to, venue, and lat and lng. Dates in q (today, tomorrow, Friday, this weekend, Nov 14, 2026-11-14) are read in the venue's time zone. Each event lists bookable Park Graph lots within a mile (lots; each lot_id works with get_lot, the quote tool and reserve; event_price where the lot set one), lots nearby that take parking requests (request_lots, each with a request_url, where a driver leaves an email; not bookable) and the event's page (event_url). partner adds a partner key to every link. No API key needed. The top-level summary is a one-line, plain-language answer; an empty events list means no upcoming event matched. Every payment completes on parkgraph.com with the driver present; no tool charges money on its own.

q.description: The event in plain words: team, performer, venue and day ("Knicks game Friday at MSG")

date.description: One day (YYYY-MM-DD), in place of a day in q

from.description: First day of a date range (YYYY-MM-DD)

to.description: Last day of a date range (YYYY-MM-DD)

venue.description: A venue's name or page slug ("Madison Square Garden", "madison-square-garden")

lat.description: Latitude of a point; only venues within radius_km of it. Sent with lng

lng.description: Longitude of that point, sent with lat

radius_km.description: Distance from lat and lng to the venue, in km

partner.description: A Park Graph partner key (ptn_…), added to every link in the result

tools.name: my_sessions
tools.description: The signed-in driver's own parking: recent sessions (newest first), spaces held through this connector, and monthly passes, each with a link to its page on parkgraph.com. Requires driver sign-in to Park Graph through this connector; without sign-in the call returns SIGN_IN_REQUIRED with the sign-in page. Sessions are matched by the driver's verified sign-in email (the email on their receipts). get_session checks one session without sign-in, by phone code. Every payment completes on parkgraph.com with the driver present; no tool charges money on its own.

active_only.description: Only sessions that are parked now and holds that haven't expired

tools.name: my_vehicles
tools.description: The signed-in driver's saved vehicles (up to 5 plates, each with an optional label) and plates from their past parking that aren't saved yet. action list (the default) only reads; save adds a plate or sets its label, rename changes a label, remove deletes a saved plate. Saving or removing the same plate twice changes nothing. A saved plate works as reserve's plate. Requires driver sign-in to Park Graph through this connector; without sign-in the call returns SIGN_IN_REQUIRED with the sign-in page. Every payment completes on parkgraph.com with the driver present; no tool charges money on its own.

plate.description: The plate, for save, rename and remove (spaces and dashes are ignored)

label.description: A name for the vehicle, for save and rename ("Work truck")
